plugin.name: Out-of-band
plugin.description: Power, sensors, event logs and consoles for server BMCs over Redfish, IPMI and Intel AMT.

view.title: See BMCs
view.description: Open the Out-of-band tab and see power, health, sensors and logs.

power.title: Control power and boot
power.description: Turn machines on and off, power cycle them and choose the next boot device.

console.title: Use the serial console
console.description: Open the serial over LAN console of a machine.

media.title: Use virtual media
media.description: Mount and eject ISO images on a machine.

manage.title: Manage BMCs
manage.description: Add, change and remove BMCs, and clear their event logs.

allowServerIpmitool.label: Run ipmitool on the Termix server
allowServerIpmitool.description: When off, IPMI BMCs must use a relay host. Redfish and AMT are not affected.

description: Add the management controllers (BMCs) of your servers to power them on and off, watch their sensors and read their event logs. Logins are stored encrypted and never shown again.

confirm.off: Cut the power of {{name}}? The system does not shut down cleanly.
confirm.cycle: Power cycle {{name}}? The system does not shut down cleanly.
confirm.reset: Reset {{name}}? The system restarts at once.

form.name: Name
form.hostHint: Link the BMC to the host it belongs to. It then follows that host's sharing and shows on its host menu.
form.pollHint: At least 30 seconds, or 60 when a relay host is used.
form.relayHint: Run ipmitool on this host instead of the Termix server. Needed for the serial console.
form.cipherHint: Only change this if the BMC refuses the login. 3 is the usual one, 17 for newer BMCs.
form.caHint: Paste the PEM of the BMC's certificate authority. Leave empty for a trusted certificate.
form.caSet: A CA is saved. Paste a new one to replace it.
form.keepLogin: Leave empty to keep the saved login
form.testNeedsLogin: Enter the login again to test.

log.clearConfirm: Clear the event log of {{name}}? This cannot be undone.

boot.hint: The machine boots from this device once, then goes back to its normal order. Apply it before a restart.
boot.done: {{name}} boots from the chosen device next time

media.empty: This BMC has no virtual CD slot.

console.needsRelay: The serial console needs a relay host with ipmitool. Pick one in the BMC settings.

widget.name: Out-of-band
widget.description: Power and health of your server BMCs.
